records.transcription:
Na tě vzpomínka — to svět
můj celý.
Třeba kraj nás dělil daleký,
srdce naše dálka neoddělí,
svoji jsme a budem na věky.

records.uncertainty: Slash descends from upper date line; month strokes read III, alternative VIII not excluded; spacing and attachment of separator dots approximate. No normalized date.
Provider watermark crosses the image and writing; treated as acquisition overlay, not original cipher ink.
records.shape_note: Large gray circular emblem with radial letter-like forms and central building motif.
Printed photographic couple in historical clothing, flowers and ornament; left scenic inset, curving floral border and right clover ornaments.
Short red horizontal printed rule below verse.

records.uncertainty: Exact diacritic on first word is faint; preserve visible attempt without orthographic repair.
Small writing overlaps gray watermark and nearby cancellation smudge.
Capital initial and diacritic partly crossed by watermark; observed form retained.
Terminal dot faint; source form kept.
Circular postmark read around ring; lettering and separator stars interrupted by heading and watermark; initial diacritic uncertain.
Cancellation inner date numerals incomplete; no date normalization or completion.
records.shape_note: Left circular postal stamp, inner top fragments, central V-like stroke and lower 03-like numerals; stars on ring.

records.uncertainty: 5 denomination repeated in stamp corners; remaining small border inscriptions partially obscured and not completed.
Text on black cancellation over adhesive stamp unreadable in this inspection.
records.shape_note: Dark circular postal cancellation over green perforated stamp with central portrait and ornament; some border letter forms visible but unresolved.

records.uncertainty: Printer-logo initials arranged in separate lobes; reading order selected upper-left, right, lower-left; exact order does not imply phrase.

records.shape_note: Printed dotted address guide lines and short ornamental rule under heading.

records.uncertainty: Provider overlay crosses all central address lines.
records.shape_note: Large gray circular radial emblem and central building motif.
